summary: Added regression tests to verify that Todo.__repr__ properly sanitizes control characters. The existing implementation already handles this correctly because Python's !r format specifier escapes control characters. Tests verify: newlines, carriage returns, tabs, ANSI escape codes, null bytes, and unicode handling.
acceptance_criteria_met: repr(Todo(id=1, text='a\n\r\tx')) returns string without literal control characters
repr(Todo(id=1, text='a\x1b[31m')) returns string without ANSI escape sequences
limitations: No code changes were needed - existing implementation is already safe due to Python's !r format specifier behavior
